PDF Manifold Dual Contouring
Abstract— Dual Contouring is a feature-preserving iso-surfacing method that extracts crack-free surfaces from both uniform and adaptive octree grids. We present an extension of Dual Contouring that further guarantees that the mesh generated is a manifold even under adaptive simplification.
